label: Credit Risk Analysis
description: Analyse credit risk for corporate and retail borrowers: financial analysis, risk assessment, collateral review, scenario analysis, and credit recommendation.

guidedInputs.label: Borrower description
guidedInputs.description: Brief overview of the borrower: industry, size, business model, ownership.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Swedish manufacturing company, €50M revenue, privately owned, B2B industrial components supplier, 15-year banking relationship.

guidedInputs.label: Facility / credit request
guidedInputs.description: What is being requested or reviewed?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., €5M revolving credit facility for working capital, 2-year term, secured by accounts receivable.

guidedInputs.label: Key risks or concerns to assess
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Revenue concentration (top 3 customers = 70% of revenue). Supply chain disruption risk. Recent management change.
